name: Buffalo Pound Provincial Park - Elmview, Lakeside and Valley Campgrounds
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19. Buffalo Pound Lake is a reservoir: measured to the high-water edge. Esri World_Imagery z18 (0.37 m/px, and a 2x crop) of Lakeside and a z17 frame of the whole group with every SKPP GIS site point: Lakeside L1-L7 sit about 23-32 m from the water behind a continuous band of shoreline trees, no site on open ground to the water; SKPP site photos show the lake through the trees from L1, L2, L6 and L7. Valley lies about 170 m+ from the shore with woods and the boat-launch lot between, and Elmview south of the park road, both inland. Every paging row reads 'Near Water - no'. A screened view from Lakeside. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290170, read 2026-11-19 (paging table + every site's detail page): Elmview 34 Nightly Electric (15/30 A) + 2 Camp-Easy yurts (not counted), Lakeside 7 Nightly Electric (15/30/50 A), Valley 18 Nightly Full Service + 6 seasonal full service = 65 site-specific sites, 59 by the night. Every Elmview site's 'Allowed Equipment' stops at 'Camping Unit up to 18ft' or a tent or van/truck camper; Lakeside L1-L7 take 40-50 ft and 17 of 18 nightly Valley sites 25-40 ft (V12F posted 20 ft), so 24 nightly sites take a 23-ft rig. Park map (2026-04-10): sani dump by Elm View and the entry gate, showers and change room at the beach and pool beside Lakeside. Runs the park's winter camping (Elmview). A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
note: Provincial-park campgrounds by the beach, outdoor pool and boat launch on Buffalo Pound Lake, a reservoir in the Qu'Appelle Valley about 20 minutes northeast of Moose Jaw: Lakeside's seven sites behind a strip of shoreline trees, Valley's full-service sites in the woods behind the boat launch, and Elmview south of the park road. Every Elmview site, the winter-camping ones included, books only for a unit up to 18 ft or a tent or van, so a 23-ft rig fits Lakeside and Valley only (Valley V12F is posted at 20 ft). Showers are at the beach building. 6 Valley sites are seasonal. Maple Vale, Shady Lane and Trails End about 2.8 km northwest and Lower Chalet about 2.4 km southeast have their own entries. --Claude

season.note: 2026-27 dates. Full services May 14 to September 30; October nights booked through the park; winter camping in Elmview November 1 to March 14 with power, firewood and pit or portable toilets, but no water, showers or dump station.

fees.note: $4 a night less from October 1, with reduced services.

name: Buffalo Pound Provincial Park - Lower Chalet Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19. Esri World_Imagery z17 (0.74 m/px) with all 27 SKPP GIS site points: Lower Chalet B lies about 150 m from Buffalo Pound Lake's high-water edge with the main park road, woods and the water treatment plant between; Lower Chalet A about 350 m back in woods. SKPP site photos of LCA-1 and LCB-21, 22, 23, 25 and 26 show no lake. Every paging row reads 'Near Water - no'. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290170, read 2026-11-19 (paging table + every site's detail page): Lower Chalet A 15 + Lower Chalet B 12 = 27 site-specific 'Nightly Non-Electric' sites, all back-in, 'Site Surface: Grass', 'Access To: Washroom, Water Point'; 'Allowed Equipment' takes a 19-25 ft unit or larger on 18 (32-40 ft: LCA-1 to LCA-7, LCA-15, LCB-18 to LCB-27); LCA-8 to LCA-14 and LCB-16 and LCB-17 a tent or van/truck camper only. Area note 'Non-electrical sites located adjacent to the Buffalo Pound Water Treatment Plant.' Park map (2026-04-10): two loops on their own spurs off the main park road by the Lower Chalet visitor centre, washrooms and potable water. Grass sites with no pads: kept with a caveat. A real public drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
note: Two non-electric loops off the main park road by the Lower Chalet visitor centre at Buffalo Pound Lake, a reservoir in the Qu'Appelle Valley about 20 minutes northeast of Moose Jaw, set beside the city's water treatment plant. Sites are on grass with no gravel pads; no showers in the loops (the nearest are at the beach, about 2 km northwest). LCA-8 to LCA-14 and LCB-16 and LCB-17 book only for a tent or van camper. The Elmview, Lakeside and Valley campgrounds about 2.4 km northwest and Maple Vale, Shady Lane and Trails End beyond have their own entries. --Claude
